checks.name: invalidated_experiment:institutional_execution_v1
checks.detail: severity=registry_self_staging_dirty_flag; superseded_by=institutional_execution_v2; reason=The research outputs and hashes are valid, but the experiment registry created its temporary snapshot directory inside the repository before capturing Git status. That self-created untracked directory caused the metadata to report dirty=true even though registration began from clean commit d1b00aedd5b3dcbc660733fa64288c550a83e446.

checks.name: invalidated_experiment:portfolio_sensitivity_v1
checks.detail: severity=cost_stress_repricing_formula_superseded; superseded_by=transaction_cost_model_v1; reason=The v1 fixed-fill execution cost stress subtracted turnover times the fee rate directly from gross return. The daily executor defines turnover over pre-trade NAV while return is measured over previous NAV, so exact C0 reproduction additionally requires the pre-trade-to-previous-NAV ratio. The difference is small but the v1 stress grid is not an exact 20bp regression of the executable baseline.

checks.name: invalidated_experiment:factor_preprocessing_ablation_v1
checks.detail: severity=portfolio_metrics_invalid; superseded_by=factor_preprocessing_ablation_v2; reason=Validation portfolios were formed after filtering rows with non-null future returns. RankIC and model-selection metrics used the correct realized subset, but Top-200 portfolio metrics had outcome-availability leakage.

checks.name: invalidated_experiment:model_benchmark_v1
checks.detail: severity=portfolio_metrics_execution_idealized; superseded_by=rf_daily_retry_execution_v1; reason=Model ranking and RankIC are valid, but the benchmark Top-200 portfolio assumes every next-day rebalance is filled. RandomForest disproportionately selected stocks blocked by next-day price limits or suspensions, materially inflating validation returns and modestly inflating historical-OOS returns.

checks.name: invalidated_experiment:rf_execution_forensics_v1
checks.detail: severity=execution_timing_incomplete; superseded_by=rf_daily_retry_execution_v1; reason=The weekly constrained simulator applied a blocked next-day order only at the following weekly rebalance. It also evaluated every signal with a full five-day label even when holiday-week signal dates were fewer than five trading days apart, creating overlapping portfolio return intervals. The price-limit diagnosis remains valid, but its 19.09% validation and 24.19% historical-OOS returns are not the final executable estimates.

The affected PIT universe, factor panel, and industry exposure partitions were repaired and the experiment was rerun.
